PullRequest.Title: chat: cover pinned marketplace plugin links
PullRequest.Body:

Part of #344698. Stack 1/3; base: `main`. Followed by #345190 and #345191.

## Summary

- Cover plain, base64-encoded, and Git URL plugin links with pinned marketplace revisions.
- Verify both server-API and live-session SDK paths receive the original source, including `#feature/beta`.
- Keep SDK display descriptions separate from source identity: marketplace listing descriptions can omit a successfully registered revision.

No production changes in this PR. Live investigation with the current SDK showed it already preserves revisions, so this adds regression coverage rather than a speculative SDK workaround.

## Validation

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — passed.
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/plugins/pluginUrlHandler.test.ts --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts --grep 'PluginUrlHandler|preserves marketplace revisions|prefers a live session and preserves' --reporter dot` — 53 passed.
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/plugins/pluginUrlHandler.test.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts` — passed.
- `npm run gulp compile-client` — passed.
- Live Code OSS + dbgjs: isolated SDK clients installed inert plugin version `2.0.0` from `feature/beta` instead of default-branch version `1.0.0`, using both a Git URL and GitHub shorthand. GitHub shorthand was redirected to a local smart-HTTP fixture; no third-party plugin was installed.

Full extension build/bootstrap was blocked by existing missing TypeScript-native dependencies and registry E401. Focused client builds and the required extension outputs were available. No credentials or registry configuration were changed.

Scenarios.Scenario: Run the PluginUrlHandler browser test suite with the new pinned-revision cases
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each test constructs an in-memory fixture, parses one URL, awaits the mocked confirmation and provider methods, and performs assertions; all work completes before that test finishes.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: The diff expands the add-marketplace table from 3 to 6 fixed entries and adds 3 fixed install tests, so suite work increases by 6 bounded cases rather than scaling with user data.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Provider operations within each case are sequentially awaited; the diff adds no Promise.all, queue, burst, or changed runner-level parallelism.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache participates in the fixtures. The exact-revision case exercises the existing source comparison that skips add; different revisions exercise one add. There is no cold/warm behavior introduced by the diff.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed loop cardinality and fixture implementations are directly visible, and the mocks perform no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network operations.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact test-runner scheduling cost is not measured, but the added work is fixed, small, and uses in-memory mocks only.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The only added execution is six bounded in-memory regression cases, with no production runtime effect or expensive boundary.

Scenarios.Scenario: Run the CopilotAgent marketplace server-API and live-session tests with pinned source strings
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The two existing tests execute the same sequential marketplace method calls and assertions as before; only test names, source inputs, and expected recorded values change.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fixed at the same two existing tests and the same call cardinality. The source gains a short revision suffix but does not add collection traversal or invocation count.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Calls remain serialized by await. The server-API path uses TestCopilotClient methods and the live-session path uses local async stubs; no concurrency behavior changes.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache behavior changes. Session lookup and marketplace inventory behavior are unchanged, and the test doubles return configured in-memory values.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both changed hunks and TestCopilotClient/live-session stub implementations show unchanged operation counts and in-memory execution.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; there are no newly added cases or real boundaries, only slightly longer constant strings in existing tests.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff changes regression coverage inputs without adding runtime work or increasing test call cardinality.

Scenarios.Scenario: User opens a pinned marketplace add/install URL in the product
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After consent and session resolution, the unchanged handler lists marketplaces, conditionally adds the requested source, queries pages until the plugin is found, installs it, and opens the customization editor. These operations are on the user-visible critical path, but no production line is changed by this PR.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List registered marketplaces through the selected management provider
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same list call occurred before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before source reuse/addition is decided

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Register the marketplace source when no exact canonical source exists
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero or one call per confirmed URL after exact-source matching
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same conditional add occurred before the PR; the tests now cover pinned revisions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before querying or finishing add-only handling

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Query marketplace pages for the requested plugin
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One call per page until a matching plugin is found or pagination ends
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same pagination loop and query count existed before the PR.
The same install call occurred before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before the handler opens the marketplace UI

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One URL request; marketplace matching scales with the returned marketplace list, and plugin lookup scales with result pages. The diff does not alter either effective cardinality.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The unchanged handler serially awaits list, optional add, paginated query, and install. The diff introduces no additional concurrency or serialization.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: There is no handler cache. An exact already-registered canonical source avoids add; a missing or differently pinned source causes one add. This behavior existed before and is only newly covered by tests.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that the boundary sequence is real and entirely pre-existing; the changed files contain tests only.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider implementations may map these abstractions to IPC and network work of varying duration, but the PR changes none of their placement, count, inputs in production, or concurrency.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression because product behavior, boundary cardinality, critical-path placement, and cache behavior are unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Agent-host marketplace operations preserve a pinned revision through server API or a live SDK session
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The unchanged CopilotAgent chooses a live session or client fallback, performs one add RPC, then lists marketplaces to resolve the returned entry. The modified tests pass a pinned source through both paths.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Add a marketplace through the SDK session RPC or client RPC
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single add RPC occurred with the unpinned source.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Blocks until the add result returns

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One list RPC per successful add
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same follow-up list occurred before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Blocks return while resolving the added marketplace

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One source string per operation and one marketplace inventory scan after add. The revision suffix does not change operation count or collection size.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Add and follow-up list remain sequentially awaited; the test modification creates no burst or limiter change.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is added or bypassed. Existing live-session selection and client retry behavior are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: production call flow and changed tests show exactly the same two-RPC add path as before.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual SDK/client RPC latency is environment-dependent, but no production call count, scheduling, or payload shape beyond existing source support changes in this test-only PR.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The PR only verifies the existing path preserves the source suffix.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the full two-file, test-only diff. The new URL-handler cases add a small fixed amount of in-memory test work, while the CopilotAgent edits only alter existing test strings and expectations. Product boundary counts, serialization, caching, concurrency, startup/UI paths, and retained state are unchanged; no valid performance finding or regression-fix record was identified.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
